propositions: Extract Jira-family-general units (identity convention, probe classifier, field sanitizers, link vocabulary, value maps) from adapters/jira/ into a new adapters/jira_family/ package to establish an acyclic import graph where concrete backends import family-shared symbols, not vice versa

Relocate identity.py wholesale and split jira_fields.py by symbol: move non-dependent symbols (_sanitize_label, _sanitize_summary, InvalidLabelError, _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK, value maps) outright; move _sanitize_description and _sanitize_comment as contract-parameterized functions accepting injected RichTextCodec and comment-limit dependencies to avoid making jira_family/ import from pinned adapters/jira/ modules

Relocate the pure classifier from probe.py as classify_probe_response(issue_key, status_code, payload, resolved_status_names=...) taking resolved-status set as required keyword-only parameter, leaving Cloud's probe() and RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES in adapters/jira/probe.py to prevent silent misclassification if a DC adapter passes different workflow state names

De-duplicate pre-existing drift in local-to-Jira status and priority maps by making jira_family/ the sole definition site and adopting the outbound_fields.py value of deleted->Done (fixing a latent bug where ACLI's .title() fallback produced invalid Jira state name Deleted)

Keep adapters/jira/adf.py, adapters/jira/comment_limits.py, and adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py at their pinned paths and share them by dependency inversion: pinned modules import jira_family contracts, never the reverse; use absolute imports (never relative) in pinned modules to survive spec_from_file_location load with __package__==''

Update all internal importers and mock.patch strings to re-point at new jira_family/ paths with no re-export shims; use aliased imports in acli*.py (from ...jira_family import sanitize_label as _sanitize_label) to keep module-local underscore names and __all__ byte-identical so the ACLI transport diff is provably import-lines-only
